knowledge_tree.title: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Book 1
knowledge_tree.content: English textbook for fourth-grade students covering topics like family, friends, community, weather, and seasons.

children.title: Unit 1: Helping at Home
children.content: Learn about family roles, jobs, and how to help at home.

children.title: Family Members and Jobs
children.content: Identify and describe family members and their occupations.

children.title: Job Vocabulary
children.content: Words for occupations: doctor, farmer, nurse, office worker, factory worker, etc.

children.title: Asking About Jobs
children.content: Question structure: 'What's your mother's job?' 'She's a doctor.'

children.title: Helping at Home
children.content: Learn chores and how to assist family members.

children.title: Chore Vocabulary
children.content: Words for chores: clean, cook, sweep the floor, look after, etc.

children.title: Expressing Ability
children.content: Using 'can' for ability: 'I can clean my room.' 'Can you help?'

children.title: Phonics: 'ch' Sound
children.content: Pronunciation and spelling of words with 'ch': teach, chair, lunch, Chinese, etc.

children.title: Unit 2: My Friends
children.content: Describe friends' appearances, personalities, and activities.

children.title: Describing People
children.content: Use adjectives to describe physical appearance and character.

children.title: Adjectives for Appearance
children.content: Words like tall, short, strong, thin, long hair, short hair, etc.

children.title: Adjectives for Character
children.content: Words like kind, quiet, funny, etc.

children.title: Activities with Friends
children.content: Talk about common activities done with friends.

children.title: Activity Vocabulary
children.content: Words like play games, play football, read books, help with English/Chinese, etc.

children.title: Using Verbs with Friends
children.content: Sentence structures: 'He often reads books with me.' 'She helps me with English.'

children.title: Phonics: 'sh' Sound
children.content: Pronunciation and spelling of words with 'sh': fish, share, shop, she, English, ship, etc.

children.title: Unit 3: Places We Live In
children.content: Learn about community places and activities done there.

children.title: Community Places
children.content: Identify and describe locations in a community.

children.title: Place Vocabulary
children.content: Words like park, hospital, shop, playground, bus stop, toilets, library, gym, etc.

children.title: There is/There are
children.content: Using 'There is' and 'There are' to describe existence: 'There is a park.' 'There are many people.'

children.title: Community Activities
children.content: Talk about what people do in different community places.

children.title: Activity Vocabulary
children.content: Words like go shopping, do sports, take a walk, see a doctor, etc.

children.title: Expressing Habits
children.content: Using adverbs of frequency: 'I often take a walk there.'

children.title: Phonics: 'ck' Sound
children.content: Pronunciation and spelling of words with 'ck': back, black, duck, sock, tick, etc.

children.title: Unit 4: Helping in the Community
children.content: Learn about community jobs and how to help others.

children.title: Community Jobs
children.content: Identify and describe jobs that help the community.

children.title: Job Vocabulary
children.content: Words like cleaner, cook, delivery worker, bus driver, police officer, firefighter, etc.

children.title: Describing Job Actions
children.content: Using present continuous: 'He is cleaning the playground.' 'She is cooking.'

children.title: Ways to Help
children.content: Learn how young people can assist in their community.

children.title: Helping Actions
children.content: Phrases like make the bed, tell stories, sing songs, draw pictures, etc.

children.title: Expressing Ongoing Actions
children.content: Using present continuous for current activities: 'Chen Jie is making the bed.'

children.title: Phonics: 'ph' Sound
children.content: Pronunciation and spelling of words with 'ph': elephant, Philip, phone, photo, etc.

children.title: Unit 5: The Weather and Us
children.content: Learn about weather conditions and related activities.

children.title: Weather Vocabulary
children.content: Describe different weather conditions.

children.title: Weather Terms
children.content: Words like sunny, windy, snowy, rainy, cloudy, hot, cold, warm, cool, etc.

children.title: Asking About Weather
children.content: Question structure: 'What's the weather like?' 'It's sunny.'

children.title: Weather Activities
children.content: Talk about activities suitable for different weather conditions.

children.title: Activity Vocabulary
children.content: Words like play basketball, fly a kite, see a film, make a snowman, read books, etc.

children.title: Expressing Possibility
children.content: Using 'can' for possibility: 'We can play basketball.' 'We can't fly a kite.'

children.title: Phonics: 'th' Sound
children.content: Pronunciation and spelling of words with 'th': thank, think, these, they, there, three, them, thin, etc.

children.title: Unit 6: Changing for the Seasons
children.content: Learn about seasons, clothing, and seasonal activities.

children.title: Seasons
children.content: Identify and describe the four seasons.

children.title: Season Vocabulary
children.content: Words: spring, summer, autumn, winter.

children.title: Describing Seasons
children.content: Using adjectives: 'Spring is green.' 'Winter is white.'

children.title: Clothing
children.content: Learn about clothing items and possessive pronouns.

children.title: Clothing Vocabulary
children.content: Words like sweater, socks, dress, shirt, coat, T-shirt, gloves, etc.

children.title: Possessive Pronouns
children.content: Using 'whose' and possessive forms: 'Whose sweater is it?' 'It's mine.' 'It's Lu Wei's.'

children.title: Seasonal Activities
children.content: Talk about activities specific to each season.

children.title: Activity Vocabulary
children.content: Words like fly a kite, make a snowman, take a walk, play games, sing songs, etc.

children.title: Expressing Preferences
children.content: Using 'like' for preferences: 'Which season do you like?' 'I like winter.'

children.title: Phonics: 'wh' Sound
children.content: Pronunciation and spelling of words with 'wh': where, who, why, white, which, what, whose, etc.
